# Vendored TraigentSchema contracts (TRAIG-101)

Byte-exact copies of the closed wire contracts the reactive client is tested against.
`tests/unit/runtime/test_reactive_client.py` fails if any byte drifts from the pin below.
To refresh: copy the files from the new TraigentSchema ref with `git show <ref>:<path>`,
update the pins, and say so in the PR.

Source: Traigent/TraigentSchema origin/develop, root `traigent_schema/schemas/`.
